text:
maria: Starting quick post-rollout sweep for canary-3 — image rwinf/engine:2026.3.1. Please run smoke checks and call out anything odd. 10m observation window.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout completed to pool canary-3 — 4 instances. Duration 2m. No immediate failures reported. :white_check_mark:

sam: quick functional smoke: ran curl against /generate, response 200 and model responded with short text. command: ```curl -sS -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hello"}' | jq '.status'``` -> \"ok\"

alex: Observability quick glance: p50=4ms, p95=11ms, error rate=0.01% for canary-3 routes. Grafana: https://grafana.company/r/redwood/canary-3?from=now-30m

priya: Noting a small tail increase on embeddings route after the rollout — p95 up ~4ms vs baseline. KV-cache hit dropped 91% -> 88% on canary nodes. Might be warmup/quant offset.

maria: thanks. @alex can you validate batching window & kernel selection? If p95 stays >15ms we should consider adjusting batch window back to 15ms.

alex: toggled a conservative batch window tweak in config (staging->canary flag): ```rwctl set batch.window=10ms --env=canary-3``` — monitoring. will revert if p95 drifts up.

sam: found a minor metrics exporter path that returns 404 on one pod; pushing tiny hotfix PR #4587 (no model path changes). Deploying rollout for the exporter next.

priya: rollback readiness check: current image is pinned to rwinf/engine:2026.3.1; previous stable tag rwinf/engine:2026.2.9. rollback command: ```deploy rollback --pool canary-3 --image rwinf/engine:2026.2.9```

maria: let's hold rollback unless error rate >0.5% or p95 >40ms for more than 3 minutes. Otherwise continue observation for full 10m. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Monitor policy attached: prod/canary/latency-watch. Alerts will notify #oncall and @pagerduty on breach.

alex: All checks still green at 6m. embeddings tail stabilized after cache warmed, now at +1ms. No action needed.

sam: exporter fix rolled to canary, metrics endpoint now consistent across pods.

maria: good progress — keep this thread updated. If anything breaches the gate, call it out and we'll run rollback. Otherwise I'll mark handoff in 4m.

alex: will post final signoff or rollback notice by +10m.

priya: leaving a note: capture a short eval run against typical prompt set (10 examples) in 20m to ensure quality metrics stable.

maria: noted — follow-up eval run scheduled. thanks all.
